subject: Quarterly prep - pipeline closeout, forecast harmonization & account rollcall
messages:
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@acme.com>
To: logan_wright@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-01T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: QBR prep - timeline and what we need from you

Hi Logan,

We have our internal QBR with the exec committee on June 10 and I want to make sure Redwood's part of the packet is up to date. Can we schedule a 30-minute run-through next week to confirm: consolidated forecast numbers, any outstanding procurement docs, and a one-page summary for each account (owners + risk / next steps)?

What I can provide from our side: updated procurement contact and a current budget approval timeline. Ideally we'd like the mutual action plan and a concise account rollcall.

Thanks,
Sarah Nguyen
Head of Cloud Partnerships | Acme Corp

--
Attachment: (none in this message)

From: logan_wright@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@acme.com>, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-01T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep - timeline and what we need from you

Thanks for the heads up, Sarah — we can support this. Proposed plan:

1) Internal sync (Redwood owners only) — June 2, 10:00 AM PT — 30m
2) Draft consolidated forecast + account one-pagers — Marcus to own by June 3 EOD
3) Share mutual action plan + procurement questionnaire back to Acme — Olga to own by June 4
4) Final review with Acme — June 7, 11:00 AM PT

Attachments I will circulate after our internal sync: a one-pager template and a master forecast CSV.

Quick asks for internal team:
- Marcus: please include HubSpot deal IDs and your confidence band (best / likely / commit %) per account.
- Olga: prep the procurement questionnaire answers and call out any outstanding security evidence.
- Ben: consolidate CPL/rate assumptions and any committed discounts into the forecast CSV.

Sarah — does this cadence work for you? If so, we'll send calendar invites.

Best,
Logan Wright
Senior Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?id=redwood-qbr

--
Attachment (to be added after internal): Acme_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_2027.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: logan_wright@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-02T08:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR prep - timeline and what we need from you

On Tue, Jun 1, 2027 at 11:15 AM Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for the heads up, Sarah — we can support this. Proposed plan:

Joined the plan — a few notes from my side after a quick HubSpot pull:

Account rollcall (accounts touching this deal):
- Acme Core Platform (Deal HS-1234567) — Owner: Marcus Lin — Stage: Negotiation — Forecast: likely $420k (commit band 60%)
- Acme Data Labs (Deal HS-1234589) — Owner: Olga Petrov (co-sell) — Stage: Final Review — Forecast: likely $180k (commit band 70%)
- Acme Edge (Deal HS-1234591) — Owner: Ben Carter — Stage: Procurement — Forecast: best $95k / likely $60k / commit $40k

Forecast notes: I trimmed Acme Edge from likely to commit due to procurement timeline. Total consolidated likely = $660k; commit $520k.

Attached: a short CSV export with line items and HubSpot IDs. I'll add a one-paragraph owner summary per account for the one-pagers.

Marcus
Principal Account Exec | Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: pipeline_export_ACME_20270602.csv (csv stub)

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: logan_wright@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-03T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Procurement contact and questions from Acme

Forwarding Acme's procurement thread — procurement@acme.com added procurement lead (David Brown). Acme attached their standard procurement questionnaire; I've started filling it out.

Key items to flag for QBR:
- Data residency: Acme asked for confirmation that inference traffic will remain in-us for PII workloads (we can confirm VPC/private deployment options).
- Audit log retention: they requested 13 months of audit logs (we normally do 12 by default; need an exception note).
- Contract milestone: CFO approval expected June 9. That drives the procurement gating for Acme Edge.

I've attached our draft answers and highlighted the two asks above. If legal needs to chime in on audit retention exception, flag it now.

Olga Petrov
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: Acme_Procurement_Questions.xlsx (xlsx stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: logan_wright@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai, Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: 2027-06-04T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Consolidated forecast and next steps (final)

All — attached is the consolidated forecast CSV (pipeline_consolidation_ACME_20270604.csv) and a single-page owner summary pack for each account (in the shared Drive link). Highlights: 

- Consolidated likely = $660,000; Consolidated commit = $520,000
- Key risks: audit log retention exception (legal escalation), Acme Edge procurement timing (depends on CFO signoff June 9)
- Recommended next steps for QBR packet: include the one-pagers and the mutual action plan, and call out the two risk items as follow-ups with legal and infra.

Sarah — please confirm you received the attachments. Marcus / Olga / Logan — please reply if you sign off on the packet for sharing with Acme execs. If I don't hear objections by EOD June 5, I'll mark this as ready to publish and send to Sarah for packet inclusion.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

--
